cmd.prepare.help: Initialize a VEAF mission folder with default templates.

cmd.build.help: Build a DCS mission (.miz) from a VEAF mission folder.

cmd.build.opt.log_modules: Comma-separated module IDs to set log level for (e.g. SPAWN,RADIO).

cmd.inject_weather.help: Inject weather variants from a YAML config into .miz missions.
cmd.inject_aircraft.help: Inject aircraft group templates from a YAML file into a .miz mission.
cmd.extract_aircraft.help: Extract aircraft group templates from a .miz mission to a YAML file.
cmd.validate_aircraft.help: Validate an aircraft templates YAML file without injecting.
cmd.about.help: Show information about VEAF Mission Creation Tools.

generated.mission_yaml.header:
mission.yaml — VEAF mission configuration
Generated by: veaf-tools generate-config

Place this file at the root of your mission folder.
All sections are optional — remove or comment out what you don't need.
See: https://github.com/VEAF/VEAF-Mission-Creation-Tools/blob/master/doc/MISSION_MAKER_GUIDE.md
generated.mission_yaml.section.global_lo:
── Global log level ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Forces all VEAF loggers to this level. Remove or set to 'info' for players.
Values: error | warning | info | debug | trace
generated.mission_yaml.section.settings:
── Generic settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Arbitrary veaf.config.XXX = value assignments.
generated.mission_yaml.section.modules:
── Module configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Enable/disable individual VEAF Lua modules and override their log level.
Modules not listed here default to enabled.

generated.mission_yaml.section.cap:

generated.mission_yaml.section.combat:

report.missionconfig.dofiles_intro:
In v6 the builder injects all VEAF scripts automatically via `veaf-scripts.lua`.
Explicit `doFile(...)` calls are no longer needed. They have been commented out
with a `-- [v6 migration]` prefix — verify them before deleting permanently.
